steps.title: Open the live Cockpit
steps.narration: Tapeology opens on the Cockpit, where a stock's price action can update live in front of you.
steps.point_out: The Tapeology home screen, ready to watch a ticker.

steps.title: Choose the simulated tape
steps.narration: You can watch a simulated stock first. You do not need a live market feed to see how a read works.
steps.point_out: The Simulated option is selected and ready for a ticker name.

steps.title: Name the simulated ticker
steps.narration: Typing a name sets up which simulated stock the tape will follow.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now holds the name just typed.

steps.title: Watch the tape settle into a read
steps.narration: Price bars move in real time. The tape settles into a plain-English read, like "Buyer Control."
steps.point_out: The live read label above the moving price bars.

steps.title: Open the Desk
steps.narration: The Desk lists about 100 stocks, ranked by how close each one sits to a key price level. Each row also says how old its price reading is.
steps.point_out: The ranked rows, and the panel naming exactly which price data built this screen.

steps.title: Look back at a past scan
steps.narration: Every past screen is saved. Look back at any of them, exactly as it was recorded.
steps.point_out: A note confirming this is an older, saved screen, not today's.

expect.text: Viewing the recorded screen for 2026-06-22 — not the latest.

steps.title: Jump from a row into its chart
steps.narration: Clicking any row opens that stock's detailed chart, already loaded for the same date.
steps.point_out: The Structure page opens, pre-filled from the row just clicked.
